What comes next?

Say the shape names, draw them on paper, or point to the pictures. Find the group that repeats, then predict what comes next. You can use the shape names alone; the colors are optional.

Inspired by Rainbow Kindergarten, credited to @Katielyl in the historical inventory (page 10). The activities are new for the prototype. They have no timer and save no progress.

1. Switch back and forth

?

Circle, square, circle, square. Name the next shape.

Check pattern 1

Circle. The repeating group is circle, square.

2. Two of one shape

?

Triangle, triangle, circle, triangle, triangle. Name the next shape.

Check pattern 2

Circle. The repeating group is triangle, triangle, circle.

3. Three different shapes

?

Square, circle, triangle, square, circle. Name the next shape.

Check pattern 3

Triangle. The repeating group is square, circle, triangle.

Make one to share aloud

Choose a group of two or three shapes. Repeat it twice, then say it one more time with the last shape missing. Ask someone to finish it, or come back later and solve your own pattern.
